visual_budget_note: Maximum eight. Start with slides 4, 7, 11, 12, 14. Treat 3, 8, 9 as optional — drop if crowding or weak visual meaning at projected distance. Record dropped visuals honestly.

priority_tier_1.job_from_matrix: Agentic-AI definition plus independent forecast cards
priority_tier_1.proposed: ascending ladder: chatbot > copilot > agent > multi-agent
priority_tier_1.constraints: Conceptual only. Forecast cards remain text-only.
priority_tier_1.drop_if: ladder creates crowding or overlaps text content

priority_tier_1.job_from_matrix: Independent 95% organization and 5% integrated-pilot cards plus separate investment/P&L context band
priority_tier_1.proposed: TWO SEPARATE horizontal bars (95% crimson, 5% gold) in distinct visual groups + separate range indicator for USD 30-40B below
priority_tier_1.constraints: CRITICAL: No stacked bar. No shared axis. No pie/donut. No connector. No common denominator. No proportional layout. Each bar has own visual group with distinct population label. USD 30-40B band visually disconnected. Source/qualifier text visible inside or immediately adjacent to each bar.
priority_tier_1.dom_structural_requirement: Each group independently identifiable in DOM, not merely separated by color

priority_tier_1.proposed: horizontal SVG flow: Dữ liệu đúng → Quy trình rõ → Tích hợp an toàn → Kết quả đo lường
priority_tier_1.constraints: Process diagram, not a chart. No numerical encoding.

priority_tier_1.proposed: circular SVG loop with crimson approval gate and gold human-approval node
priority_tier_1.constraints: Human approval visually distinct (different shape + color + label). Decision points in crimson.

priority_tier_1.proposed: signed flow with shape/position/sign labels; 39% skills in separate visual group with qualifier
priority_tier_1.constraints: Qualifier visible. NOT all attributed to AI. 39% must not imply AI-caused displacement. Use shape, sign, labels, position as meaning — not green color alone.

priority_tier_2_optional.job_from_matrix: Hero metric with horizon and qualifier
priority_tier_2_optional.proposed: large numeric anchor + horizon/2030 marker. NOT a bar. No axis, no baseline, no comparison.
priority_tier_2_optional.drop_if: any layout implies unstated denominator, comparison, or axis

priority_tier_2_optional.job_from_matrix: Hơn 40% banner plus three risk pillars
priority_tier_2_optional.proposed: dominant banner number >40% + three labeled risk pillars with SVG icons and Vietnamese text labels
priority_tier_2_optional.constraints: Qualifier visible. Icons have Vietnamese text labels; no color-only meaning.
priority_tier_2_optional.drop_if: icons create crowding or weak visual meaning at projected distance

priority_tier_2_optional.proposed: descending depth stack with opacity gradient, gold layer markers
priority_tier_2_optional.constraints: Illustrative, not to scale. No quantitative encoding.
priority_tier_2_optional.drop_if: depth stack does not add meaning beyond current CSS card layout

slides_not_in_scope.slide_1: hero/speaker card — unchanged, NTU logo already present
slides_not_in_scope.slide_6: iceberg — already visually encoded as metaphor in CSS
slides_not_in_scope.slide_13: 2x2 matrix — already structurally encoded in CSS grid

svg_contract.aria_attribute: aria-labelledby referencing title and desc IDs
svg_contract.language: Vietnamese with proper diacritics in all visible and accessible text
svg_contract.qualifier_visibility: source and qualifier text visible inside or immediately adjacent to every factual SVG
svg_contract.min_text_px: 18px at 1280x720 authored stage before stage transform
svg_contract.no_external: no CDN, no JS libs, no Canvas, no external fonts, no stock photos
svg_contract.reduced_motion: all SVG animations disabled, final state shown
svg_contract.print: static, full opacity, no animation artifacts
